# PCKlinik

PCKlinik is a computer and Mac repair workshop on Falkoner Allé 108, 2000 Frederiksberg (Copenhagen), Denmark. We repair all major PC and Mac brands, offer task-based services (SSD upgrades, data recovery, virus removal, liquid-damage repair, network setup), sell new and refurbished computers, and provide fixed-price Business IT support for companies. Standard diagnostics are free (2–4 days) or express for 600 kr (1–2 hours), with a fixed quote before any work begins. Phone: 91 81 61 81. Email: contact@pcklinik.eu (general) / support@pcklinik.eu (business IT).
